questions.question: What was the nationwide age-adjusted death rate for Alzheimer disease during the 12-month period ending in the first quarter of 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_vsrr_quarterly_mortality_estimates.csv')
filtered = df[
    (df['Year and Quarter'] == '2023 Q1') &
    (df['Time Period'] == '12 months ending with quarter') &
    (df['Cause of Death'] == 'Alzheimer disease') &
    (df['Rate Type'] == 'Age-adjusted')
]
result = float(filtered['Overall Rate'].iloc[0])

questions.question: In the single 3-month period of 2023 Q1, was the nationwide age-adjusted mortality rate from cancer higher for males or for females?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_vsrr_quarterly_mortality_estimates.csv')
filtered = df[
    (df['Year and Quarter'] == '2023 Q1') &
    (df['Time Period'] == '3-month period') &
    (df['Cause of Death'] == 'Cancer') &
    (df['Rate Type'] == 'Age-adjusted')
].iloc[0]

result = 'Rate Sex Male' if filtered['Rate Sex Male'] > filtered['Rate Sex Female'] else 'Rate Sex Female'

questions.question: In the 12-month period ending in 2023 Q1, did West Virginia have an age-adjusted overall death rate exceeding 1,000 deaths per 100,000 across all causes?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_vsrr_quarterly_mortality_estimates.csv')
filtered = df[
    (df['Year and Quarter'] == '2023 Q1') &
    (df['Time Period'] == '12 months ending with quarter') &
    (df['Cause of Death'] == 'All causes') &
    (df['Rate Type'] == 'Age-adjusted')
]
rate = filtered['Rate West Virginia'].iloc[0]

questions.question: During the single 3-month period of 2023 Q1, what was the average crude death rate from firearm-related injuries across the three youngest age groups: ages 1-4, ages 5-14, and ages 15-24?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_vsrr_quarterly_mortality_estimates.csv')
filtered = df[
    (df['Year and Quarter'] == '2023 Q1') &
    (df['Time Period'] == '3-month period') &
    (df['Cause of Death'] == 'Firearm-related injury') &
    (df['Rate Type'] == 'Crude')
].iloc[0]

rates = [filtered['Rate Age 1-4'], filtered['Rate Age 5-14'], filtered['Rate Age 15-24']]
result = round(sum(rates) / len(rates), 1)

questions.question: Which three states had the highest age-adjusted drug overdose mortality rates during the 12 months ending in 2023 Q1?
questions.answer: ["Rate West Virginia", "Rate District of Columbia", "Rate Delaware"]
questions.program:
import pandas as pd
import json

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_vsrr_quarterly_mortality_estimates.csv')
filtered = df[
    (df['Year and Quarter'] == '2023 Q1') &
    (df['Time Period'] == '12 months ending with quarter') &
    (df['Cause of Death'] == 'Drug overdose') &
    (df['Rate Type'] == 'Age-adjusted')
]

state_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith('Rate ') and c not in ['Rate Sex Female', 'Rate Sex Male', 'Rate 65-74'] and not c.startswith('Rate Age')]
state_series = filtered[state_cols].iloc[0]
top3 = state_series.nlargest(3).index.tolist()
result = json.dumps(top3)
